windowsBinarySources.notes: Official PGroonga 4.1.0 has five Windows x64 ZIP assets (one each for PostgreSQL 14–18). Independently pinned ZIPs each contain 43 DLL/EXE members and 20 license/NOTICE-named documents; these are member counts, NOT 43 ZIPs or accepted legal notices. / 公式ZIPはPG14～18向けの計5件。各ZIP内のDLL/EXEは43ファイル、権利文書名のファイルは20件（権利・来歴審査完了ではありません）。Source is upstream only: pgextwin public GET for PGroonga is NOT authorized / pgextwin経由の取得は未認可。

candidateRationale: Official original Windows ZIPs for PostgreSQL 14–18 passed exact-byte inventory, PGP/SQL and selected runtime tests. A path-exact 43-binary/20-rights-document *candidate* matrix exists. Variable Groonga source ('groonga-latest.zip'), xxHash and statically embedded libraries, precise producer component versions, license/NOTICE closure, full runtime dependency closure and independent signed pgextwin GET admission remain UNVERIFIED. No PGroonga ZIP is available through the public pgextwin CLI. / PG14～18の公式原本・一部実動作を確認済み。ただし可変Groonga原本、静的依存、権利・来歴、独立署名認可が未成立のため、公開pgextwin CLIからは取得不可。
